items.text: Videos from the nights of September 20 and 21 show a colorful luminous object in the sky of Tehran. Earlier, a video of this object appearing in the skies of Tehran and Isfahan was released. These images were received by Iran International.

Ali Asghar Asiabari won the silver medal in the 84 kg karate final at the Nagoya Asian Games after losing 9-1 to Mohammad Al-Jaafari from Jordan. He defeated Abdullah Babikra from Qatar and Abdullah Al-Khatib from Palestine in earlier rounds. This is the second silver medal for the Iranian team in these games.

Abbas Aliabadi, the Minister of Energy, responded to a parliamentary question about electricity and water issues by calling the water and electricity industry a strength of the Islamic Republic. He attributed power outages to attacks by the United States. The minister emphasized that the enemies of the revolution seek to disrupt the country's service system.

The Tehran prosecutor announced that 2,191 bank accounts have been blocked and 37 vehicles belonging to 394 people have been seized. These actions were taken due to allegations of cooperating with the enemy related to the war and protests in 1404. This news was announced by the Tehran prosecutor.

Turkish Airlines' representative announced that all flights to Iran are suspended until at least April next year. Emirates, Lufthansa, and Austrian Airlines have also temporarily stopped their flights to Iran. Qatar Airways is not flying to Iran due to airspace restrictions.

Fatemeh Zahra Saeedabadi lost 6-4 to Faya Robert from Malaysia in the 55-kg karate final at the 2026 Nagoya Asian Games and won a silver medal. Saeedabadi defeated representatives from Indonesia, Laos, and Singapore in earlier rounds. The Iranian karate team had a successful day with four finalists, including Morteza Nemati who won gold.

The exhibition "From Evin, with Love" opened in Munich on the fourth anniversary of the "Woman, Life, Freedom" uprising. The exhibition features handicrafts made by female political prisoners in Evin Prison. Organizers consider these works symbols of resistance and the preservation of human dignity.

A group of customs clearance agents and company owners held a protest at Khorramshahr customs demanding their demands be addressed. They called for lifting restrictions and preventing monopoly in the car import market. They also requested equal conditions for economic activists.

A video shows a protester in Shiraz writing the slogan "Long live the Shah" next to the Lion and Sun flag on a wall. This video was sent to Iran International. The incident took place in the city of Shiraz.

Raha Akhavan, a university professor and swimmer, earned the 'Three Crowns' badge on September 21 by crossing the English Channel. After about 20 hours of swimming, she finished and became the first Iranian woman to receive the 'Three Crowns' title. This badge is awarded to swimmers who have completed three routes including the English Channel.

A video published on social media shows severe crowding and congestion at the Razi border in West Azerbaijan province on Tuesday, September 21. Following an urgent order from the US Treasury Department, all international activities of Iranian airlines worldwide must cease from September 23 (October 1).

Yesterday, employees of Pars Oil and Gas Company and Continental Oil Company held protests in various sections and offshore platforms. They demanded the removal of salary caps, full payment of wages, and adjustment of minimum wages. Other demands included preventing the merger of the oil pension fund and full payment of workers' service years.

Morteza Kazemian called Mohsen Rezaei's claim about the tunnels in southern Lebanon a big lie. He referred to reports from government media about the presence of Quds Force and Hezbollah forces in these tunnels. Kazemian stated that Iranian officials do not provide clear answers about the costs and consequences of these projects.

Hananeh Kia, a 22-year-old woman and protester killed in the Mahsa uprising, was shot dead on September 21, 2022, in Nowshahr. Her mother released a video showing remaining images of her daughter and her funeral ceremony. In one image, Hananeh is seen bloodied on a hospital bed.

Several faculty members subject to recruitment calls from 2020 to 2023 protested their uncertain employment status near the Plan and Budget Organization in Tehran. They held a gathering and sit-in to express their grievances.

Iraq's aviation authority is awaiting the Prime Minister's decision on halting flights from Iran. Erbil and Sulaymaniyah airports are also waiting for Baghdad's decision. If implemented, flights from Iran to the Kurdistan Region airports will be stopped.

A merchant warned about high inflation in Iran in a social media video. He said it is better to stay unemployed at home than to start a business that will destroy your capital. These remarks reflect concerns about the economic situation.
A man who killed his ex-wife, Leila Azari, in Bukan was sentenced to death in the primary court.

Artin Khajouie-Nia, a 16-year-old student, died from a gunshot in front of the city hall of Qods on the evening of January 8, 2026. A video showing his school days has been released. This incident took place in the city of Qods.

Marco Rubio, the US Secretary of State, told NBC News that there are currently no plans for a meeting between Donald Trump and Masoud Pezeshkian, but Washington is ready for such a meeting. Rubio stated that Trump is open to meeting and discussing with others, as he believes engagement is important for resolving issues. He identified Washington's ultimate goal as preventing the Islamic Republic from acquiring nuclear weapons.
The US has increased pressure on Iran's aviation industry. International flights from Iran have become more limited. Some Iran International viewers have welcomed these pressures.

Reports indicate a sharp rise in living costs, including school clothing prices, public school tuition, and laptops. Internet taxi drivers will strike for one week starting October 1 due to increased expenses and low fares. Economic difficulties and heavy debts among merchants and workers have also been reported.

US President Donald Trump wrote on Truth Social on Tuesday, Shahrivar 31, that the country has more ammunition than can be imagined and is increasing its stockpiles to unprecedented levels. He also rejected claims of ammunition shortages, saying those who say so are 'cowards and traitors'.
A video shows a government supporter in Mashhad harassing women over hijab in a bus. When he realizes one of the women is filming him, he attacks her. This video was received by Iran International.

Faezeh Mostaan was killed on January 8 during public protests in Gohardasht, Karaj by direct fire from Khamenei's forces. This incident occurred during public protests. Her memory remains a guiding light for freedom seekers.

On Monday, 21 September, a minibus carrying factory workers overturned on the Yazd to Meybod route. The accident resulted in eight workers being injured. More details are available from Harana News Agency.
The fourth anniversary of Ghazaleh Chalabi's death was held with the presence of her mother during the Mahsa uprising. Ghazaleh Chalabi was shot and killed by officers on September 21, 2022, in Amol.

Intelligence forces raided the workplace of a young man in Abadan and arrested him for possessing a Starlink device. After working for 10 days, he intended to return home but was transferred to an unknown location. His family has no information about his status or whereabouts, and inquiries are met with threats.

The first day of speeches by world leaders at the 81st UN General Assembly begins in New York. The session takes place amid the US-Iran conflict, ongoing war in Ukraine, and escalating tensions in the Middle East. More details are provided in an interview with an Iran International reporter.

Mehdi Taj, head of Iran's Football Federation, confirmed indirect pressures to exclude the national team from the Asian Cup. FIFA has raised questions on this matter, and documented responses have been provided. Taj emphasized the need to comply with FIFA rules domestically to avoid giving others any excuse.

The Israeli Prime Minister accused the New York mayor of supporting Hamas and escalating tensions against Jews in a video before the UN General Assembly. He stated he will speak about Israeli soldiers and the mayor at the UN. Netanyahu expressed this accusation with the phrase "shame on you."

Le Monde reported that due to a naval blockade and disruption of port activities in the Persian Gulf, the Islamic Republic has transferred part of its trade to northern ports and the Caspian Sea route. This was discussed in an interview with Ahmad Samadi, a journalist from Iran International.

Ali Nikzad, the Deputy Speaker of the Parliament, said that negotiations are tied to the Strait of Hormuz and Iran will not back down. He stated that Iran has reached an agreement with Oman regarding the Strait of Hormuz. Nikzad emphasized that Iran's interests in the strait are secured and warned that the US and other countries will face energy problems if they continue their provocations.
A citizen sent a video stating that Golestan Dam is completely dry and has no water. Golestan Dam is located 12 kilometers northeast of Gonbad Kavus. The dam is situated on the Gorgan River.

Antonio Guterres stated at the UN General Assembly that the ceasefire in the Middle East is only a reduction in conflict intensity and civilians continue to suffer. He urged leaders to use high-level meetings to reduce tensions and engage in dialogue. Guterres emphasized that the war must stop.

The presidents of Ukraine and Pakistan have entered the hall of the United Nations General Assembly. The Iran International reporter is at the venue awaiting the arrival of other senior officials, including Donald Trump.

The Jerusalem Post reported that Abbas Araghchi, Foreign Minister of the Islamic Republic, requested a protective team from the US government for his stay in New York, and the request was approved by the US. According to a US State Department document, the Diplomatic Security Service will protect Araghchi during his presence in New York for the UN General Assembly. The document was addressed to the Islamic Republic's mission to the UN and referenced its diplomatic note of 26 Shahrivar.

The proportion of positive COVID-19 samples in Iran has increased for the fifth consecutive week, reaching 17 percent. The Ministry of Health has warned about the need to intensify care for acute respiratory infections. Additionally, the flu vaccine has not yet been distributed in pharmacies in Iran.

China's Foreign Ministry opposed the unilateral sanctions by the US on Iranian airlines. The Chinese spokesperson called these sanctions illegal. This stance came after the US Treasury Secretary announced the shutdown of Iranian airlines starting September 23.

Marco Rubio stated he is ready to meet with Iranian officials on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York. He emphasized that such a meeting should lead to a positive outcome and prevent Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons. Abbas Araghchi and Masoud Pezeshkian have also traveled to New York to attend the assembly.

A citizen in a video to Iran International says the MDF industry has died due to inflation and market recession. All workshops have closed and workers have become unemployed. The MDF industry involves converting wood scraps into compressed boards.

Ahmad Reza Radan, the commander of the Islamic Republic's police, stated that the Islamic Republic will be victorious over the enemy. He also praised the advances of the Ansar Allah fighters in Yemen. Radan declared that the definite morning of victory is near.

The dollar rate in Tehran's free market on Tuesday increased by nearly one percent compared to the previous day, reaching 233,000 tomans. The dollar price had risen to 235,000 tomans in the early hours of trading today. The dollar had closed at 230,800 tomans on Monday.

A senior Iranian official stated that Tehran has proposed reopening the Strait of Hormuz within seven days if the US reduces military pressure and takes initial steps to end the blockade of Iranian ports. This proposal has been conveyed to the US government through intermediaries and aims to revive negotiations with Washington. The Supreme National Security Council has approved this proposal.

Trump, in his speech at the UN General Assembly, referred to the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks and the third anniversary of the October 7 attack in Israel. He accused Iran of financially supporting terrorists and mentioned the internal massacres in the country. Trump warned about the potential dangers if the Iranian regime acquires nuclear weapons.

Eghtesad News website reported that the average housing price in Tehran has more than doubled compared to June last year. The average price per square meter of residential units in the capital has reached over 210 million tomans. This report was released during wartime conditions.

The Iranian women's kata team lost 5-0 to Vietnam in the final match. The team won the silver medal at the Asian Games. This is the first medal in the history of Iranian women's kata at the Asian Games.

Abbas Araghchi, Iran's foreign minister, met with the foreign ministers of Switzerland and Italy on the sidelines of the 81st UN General Assembly. He also attended the General Assembly at Iran's seat.
A woman was killed by her ex-husband with a firearm in Mohammadshahr, Karaj. The incident took place in Mohammadshahr city. Further details are not available.

Donald Trump spoke at the 81st UN General Assembly about the nuclear threat posed by Iran. He warned that if Iran obtained a nuclear shield, it would carry out widespread terrorist attacks. Trump also emphasized that he has acted against threats and made the US stronger.

On September 22, a driver reported smoke rising in the mountains around Tehran's Imam Khomeini Airport. The news was shared via a video sent to Iran International. The exact location and cause of the smoke are not specified.

Today, a group of nurses held a protest in front of the Kermanshah University of Medical Sciences building. They demanded the fulfillment of their professional and livelihood demands. The protest was held due to multiple professional and livelihood issues.

Donald Trump, in his speech at the UN General Assembly, called the Iranian government the number one supporter of terrorism in the world. He referred to the threats and history of repression by the Islamic Republic. These remarks were made at the UN General Assembly.

Donald Trump stated at the UN General Assembly that the Iranian regime massacred 72,000 people. He also mentioned Iran's support for the October 7 attacks on Israel and the September 11 attacks on the US. Trump added that the only thing not eliminated in Iran is inflation.

Donald Trump called on countries at the UN General Assembly to join the full economic isolation of Iran until it stops attacks on commercial ships and ends support for terrorism. He described the Iranian government as weak and desperate and said that if countries remain united, the world will be freed from the threat of Iranian terrorism. Trump also predicted a sharp drop in oil prices.

The imprisonment sentence of Donya Hosseini (Azad), a political prisoner, has been converted to an open sentence. According to Hrana news agency, she was released from Evin prison today, Tuesday, 31 Shahrivar, and will serve the remainder of her sentence outside prison.

Donald Trump did not answer a question from an Iran International reporter about his plans regarding Iran upon arriving at the UN General Assembly. He expressed happiness about his presence at the UN and praised the state of the US. He also had a verbal exchange with a CNN reporter.

Donald Trump said at the UN General Assembly that a decision must be made between reaching an agreement with Iran or destroying the Islamic Republic. He stated he could quickly destroy the Islamic Republic. Trump made these remarks criticizing the lack of agreement with the Islamic Republic.
Abbas Araghchi, Iran's Foreign Minister, along with his deputy Kazem Gharibabadi, arrived at the United Nations headquarters in New York on Tuesday, September 21.

The family of Rahim Kalij, a protester killed during the Mahsa uprising, fed dogs on his fourth anniversary. Rahim Kalij was 27 years old and was shot dead by government agents in Qaemshahr on September 21, 2022.

A citizen reported in a video that four workers were laid off from an industrial parts manufacturing company due to downsizing. He held the Islamic Republic responsible for this situation. This news was published by Iran International.

Donald Trump called for global unity against the Islamic Republic of Iran in his UN General Assembly speech. He described Iran as a terrorist regime and said the world could be freed from the threat of Iranian terrorism through unity. Trump also promised a sharp drop in oil prices if countries unite.

Mojtaba Khamenei wrote in a message that students must fulfill their historic mission for Iran's advancement through scientific progress. He emphasized that the power of knowledge combined with piety is a shield against the ruling system. He also pointed to the unsatisfactory living conditions of teachers and called for improvements.

A merchant told Iran International in a video that they are experiencing difficult conditions with the dollar at 230 to 240 thousand tomans. He said they are just struggling to get by. This highlights the economic difficulties faced by merchants.

Recep Tayyip Erdogan spoke at the UN General Assembly about the Gulf crisis, stating that efforts to expand conflicts are not beneficial to anyone. He said Turkey is in contact with all parties to end the conflict. Erdogan also called for reform of the Security Council and increased pressure on Israel.

Customs clearance agents and car importers in the Arvand Free Zone protested against import restrictions and bans. They also objected to the allocation of import licenses to certain companies. This group considered the process discriminatory and monopolistic.

Families of protesters killed in Gilan held a memorial at the grave of Mohammad Rasoul Momenizad. They held pictures of their children and commemorated their anniversary. Mohammad Rasoul Momenizad, 24 years old, was killed on September 21, 2022, during protests in Rasht.

Hangameh Hadiani, Iran's artistic gymnastics national athlete, ranked thirteenth in the preliminary vault competition at the Asian Games. She is the first female gymnast from Iran since the 1979 revolution to participate in the Asian Games. An interview was conducted with Mehdi Rostampour, a sports journalist.

During the first five months of the current year, 71 workers in Isfahan province died due to work-related accidents and 947 others were injured. The number of fatalities in work accidents in this province has increased by 57% compared to the same period last year.

A number of Iranians gathered in front of the British Prime Minister's office in London. They protested against the death sentences of Najmeh Amini, Ali Zarei, and other convicts. The protesters demanded their release.

Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, the Emir of Qatar, stated at the UN General Assembly that the current crisis is the result of years of delayed crisis management. He emphasized that disputes should be resolved through dialogue and negotiation and called for the establishment of a regional collective security system. He also highlighted the importance of reopening the Strait of Hormuz and preventing war.

The fourth anniversary of Behnam Laeqpour's death was held with the presence of his family. The ceremony included chants of "Behnam Jan, may your soul rest in peace." Behnam Laeqpour was one of the victims of the "Woman, Life, Freedom" uprising.

Donald Trump, Mette Frederiksen, and Jens Frederik Nielsen signed an agreement for the US military presence in Greenland. The ceremony took place after Trump's speech at the UN General Assembly. The Danish Prime Minister described the agreement as lasting and respectful of Greenland's right to self-determination.

Donald Trump stated that Tehran and Washington were in talks on Tuesday and a deal is likely. Trump emphasized that the US has prevented Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons. The British Prime Minister said he established good relations with Trump and that Britain is ready to play a role in the Middle East.

Several Arab countries mediating between the US and the Islamic Republic are negotiating to hold a high-level meeting on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. Marco Rubio stated that Donald Trump is ready to meet with Islamic Republic officials, but no meeting has been scheduled yet. Abbas Araghchi also met with Qatar's Prime Minister in New York, who is one of the main mediators.
A group of Iranians living in Madrid gathered on Tuesday, 31 Shahrivar, in front of the US embassy. They protested against executions in Iran and expressed their support for Prince Reza Pahlavi.

A handwritten note attributed to Mojtaba Khamenei was published in the Islamic Republic media after more than seven months of absence. The note, dated August 1st, is addressed to the commander of the IRGC Aerospace Force. The author thanks the commander for a report and requests continued efforts in the supply chain with regular updates.

On the fourth anniversary of Erfan Rezaei's death, his mother silently wept at his grave. Erfan Rezaei was one of the victims of the "Woman, Life, Freedom" uprising. This video was shared on social media.

Articles 13, 14, and 15 of the strategic action plan for securing the Strait of Hormuz were approved by the National Security Commission of the Parliament. According to Article 13, vessels violating the regulations of the Strait of Hormuz will face fines and temporary detention. The judiciary will establish specialized branches to enforce the law, and the Armed Forces Headquarters must submit quarterly reports.

The statement claims that Trump supports the heir of the Pahlavi dynasty and has pressured the Islamic Republic at the United Nations. It also calls for arrest warrants against some Islamic Republic officials for crimes against humanity. Trump is accused of pursuing his own interests and making deals with the Islamic regime.

Ali Nejadabbasi Bostanabad, a political prisoner, is serving his sentence in ward seven of Tabriz prison. He was sentenced to two years and one day for espionage, but his sentence was reduced to one year and eleven months. This information was reported by HRANA news agency.

Alireza Namvar Haghighi mentioned the possibility of negotiations between the Islamic Republic and the US in New York but does not expect an agreement during this trip. Direct talks may take place between Abbas Araghchi and American diplomats. Steve Witkoff is among the American diplomats potentially involved in these discussions.

Mohammad Hossein Raji expressed serious concern in a private meeting about the formation of a new wave of unrest and anti-government protests. He called for full readiness of mosques and revolutionary forces to confront these protests. Concerns were also raised about the reopening of schools and the return of teachers and students with prior cases.

Alireza Esfandiari, a protesting citizen, has been detained in Adelabad Prison in Shiraz for over seven months. The status of his case remains unclear. The reasons for his arrest and the charges against him have not been disclosed.

A student told Iran International in a video that enduring the high prices of stationery is difficult for them. They feel embarrassed that their family buys stationery for them. This highlights the economic difficulties faced by families.

Donald Trump announced that American officials held a three-hour meeting with the Iranian delegation on Tuesday. He described the meeting as very good and constructive and said another meeting is planned for the near future. Trump stated that Iran faces options of either destruction or potential greatness.

Donald Trump announced that Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met with members of the Islamic Republic delegation on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. The meeting lasted three hours and Trump described it as positive. Another meeting between the two sides will be held in the near future.

The spokesperson of the Civil Aviation Organization announced that flights from Iran to Baghdad and Muscat have been canceled. Baghdad airport will not accept Iranian flights from October 1st, and negotiations to transfer flights to Najaf airport are ongoing. Additionally, Muscat airport is not accepting Iranian passengers, and discussions on this matter continue.
Khabat Dehdar, a citizen from Sanandaj, has been sentenced by the judiciary to one year of suspended imprisonment and a fine.

Kylian Mbappe has become the top scorer in World Cup history at the age of 27 with 22 goals. He said he did not expect to reach this record at his age and considers reaching 100 international goals possible. Mbappe also commented on his chances of winning the Ballon d'Or, stating it is not an obsession but he would welcome receiving it.

Trump stated that a very good and constructive meeting with Iran took place, lasting three hours and ending about an hour ago. He mentioned that another meeting is planned for the near future. Trump also referred to two options for Iran: potential greatness or total destruction.

Trump will meet with representatives of the Arab Gulf countries on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. The discussion will focus on the war with Iran and the conflict with the Houthis. This meeting takes place amid calls from some regional officials to redefine relations with Tehran.

Pepe Losada was introduced as the new fitness coach of the Iranian national football team and assistant to Amir Ghalenoei. Mehrdad Khanban also joined the national team's technical staff. The national team is preparing for matches against Uzbekistan and Russia.

Emmanuel Macron emphasized at the UN General Assembly that freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz should not be used as a tool for extortion. He stated that reopening the Strait and respecting international law are priorities. Macron said this benefits all countries and France is committed to it.

Four prisoners were executed in Sepidar Prison in Ahvaz on September 15, 21, and 22. Two prisoners named Nemat Maqami and Hossein Ghazlavi were executed on charges of murder. Additionally, Karim Mojadam and Jalil Salamat were also executed in this prison.

A citizen reported in a video that the price of a can of tomato paste increased by 70,000 tomans in six days. The video was sent to Iran International. The issue of price increases has attracted attention.

Three prisoners were executed in Isfahan and Tabriz prisons. Death sentences for two other suspects in Tehran have been issued and confirmed. The executions took place on the 22nd and 23rd of Shahrivar.
The fate of Benjamin Netanyahu will be decided in this year's Israeli parliamentary elections. This is the first election after October 7. The election will be held on November 5.

A senior Iranian security source stated that the US has left no red lines in the region and Iran is prepared for all existing scenarios. Iran is not afraid of escalating war and is ready to impose a greater victory in a new conflict. Several types of anti-ship and surface-to-surface missiles have been successfully tested, and weapon development continues 24/7.

Sarir Moghann, a Bahá'í citizen residing in Isfahan, has been held in solitary confinement in Dolatabad prison for over 29 days. She is deprived of phone contact and has had only one short visit with her family. Her detention status remains uncertain.

Yahya Rahim Safavi stated that the Islamic Republic aims to establish lasting security in the Persian Gulf without the presence of the United States. He added that it is unlikely the US will return to the region and that Iran and Arab countries can create new security arrangements. He also expressed regret over the cancellation of the Oman meeting and blamed the US for it.
Araghchi and Witkoff met on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. This meeting was reported by IRIB. No further details were provided.

Mani Safarpour was killed on January 8, 2026, in the Salsabil neighborhood of Tehran by security forces. His father cried at the start of the school year for his son, who was supposed to go to university. A video of this moment has been shared on social media.

At the United Nations assembly, Trump spoke about either reaching an agreement or destroying the Islamic Republic. Reactions from people and critics were expressed regarding the presence of the Islamic Republic's delegation and Trump's statements. Criticisms were also directed at Iran's representatives at the assembly.

A video shows the only daughter of Amirhossein Emamjomeh visiting his tomb and blowing out his birthday candle. Amirhossein Emamjomeh was killed by gunfire during the January 8 protests in Tehran. This incident occurred in the green area of Tehran.

The Armed Forces Headquarters and Khatam al-Anbiya Base described Donald Trump's speech at the UN General Assembly as a tool for domestic propaganda and a sign of the US strategic deadlock. They stated that the Islamic Republic's armed forces are fully prepared to deliver stronger blows to the aggressors. They also expressed hope that the message of the Islamic Republic would reach the world at the UN.

Hossein Pedaran, an IT activist, was executed in September 2026 after being detained in July 2025 and held in solitary confinement for months. He was subjected to severe physical and psychological pressure and forced to confess against himself. His personal and work belongings, as well as those of his family, were confiscated during his arrest.

A video shows government forces' motorcycles parked in a school in Ahvaz. This action is part of the securitization and militarization of schools in various cities in Iran. This issue has raised concerns about military presence in schools.

The Islamic Republic has made behind-the-scenes efforts for a meeting between Pezeshkian and Trump. This topic is discussed in the audio version of Cheshmandaz. More details are provided in this report.

Steve and Jared had a constructive meeting with Iranian mediators today. Mediation has been ongoing for some time, and there is strong motivation to reach an agreement. Trump spoke about Iran's economic situation and hopes for a deal.
Fardad Farahzad mentioned Trump's new warning about the destruction of Iran in the 24 audio version.

On the first day of the UN General Assembly, world leaders discussed the Middle East crisis and shipping security in the Strait of Hormuz. France is drafting a resolution to create an international mission for this purpose. Leaders also called for de-escalation and reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

Ruhollah Rahimpour stated that the Iranian diplomatic team faces external pressures and internal opposition regarding an agreement with the US. He said there is still a chance for diplomacy but it requires clear withdrawal in nuclear, missile, and regional policies. These remarks were made in response to the US readiness for talks and the Assembly of Experts' opposition to an honorable peace.

Fereshteh Pezeshk referred to Donald Trump's remarks about the continuation of missile and drone stockpiling by the Islamic Republic. She mentioned the threat posed by these stockpiles to American forces and the region. She also stated that reaching an agreement is very difficult given the interests of powerful groups in the Islamic Republic.

Kaja Kallas, the EU foreign policy chief, raised the issue of internal repression and increased executions in Iran during her meeting with Abbas Araghchi. They also discussed diplomatic prospects for ending the US-Iran war and fully reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Kallas emphasized that shipping should be free and unobstructed in both the Strait of Hormuz and Bab-el-Mandeb.

France, in coordination with the United States, has begun drafting a UN Security Council resolution to establish an international mission to resume traffic in the Strait of Hormuz. This move followed a meeting between Macron and Trump in New York. The resolution aims to restore navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.

Mehdi Mahdavi Azad stated that alongside the ongoing maritime blockade of the Islamic Republic, flights from Iran to Turkey, Oman, and Iraq have been canceled or restricted. He described this simultaneous maritime and air restriction as an unprecedented turning point. This situation will increase the isolation of the Iranian people.

Donald Trump stated in the Gulf Cooperation Council meeting that after constructive talks, there is rapid progress toward an agreement with the Islamic Republic. He threatened Iran with financial isolation and emphasized that Washington will not allow Iran to obtain nuclear weapons. Trump also threatened to destroy Mount Kolang Gezla if any activity is detected there.

An American source present at the meeting of the US and Islamic Republic delegations in New York told Al Arabiya news network that Washington rejected Tehran's request to lift the blockade. According to this source, major differences and obstacles still exist between the two sides, and the chance of an agreement between the US and the Islamic Republic is very limited.

Morad Vaisi said that Masoud Pezeshkian and other Islamic Republic officials are met with harsh anti-regime slogans in New York. However, Reza Pahlavi is welcomed and cheered by Iranian gatherings. This issue has attracted users' attention.

The annual tour of the Islamic Republic to New York has started with flights, hotel stays, speeches, and meetings. At the end of the trip, it is usually said that the talks were useful and constructive. People are questioning what their share of this trip is and whether tensions will decrease or any decisions will be made that affect their lives.

Azerbaijan Airlines announced that flights of Iranian airlines to Azerbaijan have been suspended due to new US sanctions. This decision has been effective since Tuesday, September 21. The sanctions impose restrictions on Iran's aviation industry.

The head of the Islamic Republic government arrived in New York to participate and speak at the 81st United Nations General Assembly. In addition to the speech, he will have separate meetings with some leaders and political and cultural figures. No further details about these meetings have been provided.

Kambiz Tavana from Iran International explained the security measures at the UN General Assembly in New York. The US, as the host, is responsible for the security of delegations. The presence of Benjamin Netanyahu will create a tense political and security atmosphere.

Morad Vaisi, a senior analyst at Iran International, said that the Islamic Republic's mistakes have caused Iran to confront the world's greatest political, economic, and military power. These confrontations have imposed significant costs on the country and its people. He described these confrontations as futile and costly.

Navid Mohibi referred to Prince Reza Pahlavi's interview with Fox News emphasizing the need to end the Islamic Republic. He noted the timing is important as Washington decides between continuing negotiations, increasing pressure, or military options. Prince Reza Pahlavi stresses the issue cannot be resolved with a temporary agreement and long-term interests must be considered.

Forough Kanani, a sociology researcher, commented on a clash involving a compulsory hijab supporter and women in Mashhad. She stated that those who once represented power now face different social conditions. The aggressive reactions of these supporters should be understood within the context of changing social power dynamics.

The Iranian Press Photographers Association has called for clarification on the status of Majid Saeedi, a detained photojournalist. More than 14 days have passed since his arrest, and his family and colleagues remain unaware of his condition. The association continues legal efforts to secure his release.

Steve Witkoff, the US President's special representative, reported extensive talks with the Islamic Republic delegation on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. Mediators shuttled between the two sides throughout the day and successfully completed one round of talks. Witkoff stated that the mediators will continue their efforts.

Danny Danon, Israel's ambassador to the UN, said Israel knows where the leaders of the Islamic Republic are hiding and what actions they are taking. He warned that if the Islamic Republic attacks Israel, it will take only a few days to reach its leaders. These remarks were made in an interview with Fox News.

The Qalamro Refah website reported that the number of private schools in Iran has increased 64-fold over three decades, while the share of education in public government spending dropped from 19% to 10%. According to the report, the minimum tuition for private schools is 30 million tomans, and the maximum in Tehran for high school is 220 million tomans. Additionally, the annual minimum wage of workers is less than the maximum tuition.

Steve Witkoff, the special representative of the US President, announced that the talks on 31 Shahrivar between Washington and Tehran on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly were conducted through mediators, and the two delegations did not negotiate directly. Witkoff said mediators shuttled between the two sides throughout the day and completed one round of talks. He expressed hope that the talks would be constructive and added that mediation efforts will continue.

Ukraine is ready to sign a drone defense agreement with the United States. Volodymyr Zelensky intends to sign this agreement on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. The US Department of War and Ukraine's Ministry of Defense have developed a framework to expand Ukraine's defense technologies.

Esmail Baghaei, spokesman of the Islamic Republic's Foreign Ministry, told IRNA that the interaction with the American side took place through a Qatari mediator. He said the interaction aimed to convey Iran's conditions, including an end to the war on all fronts, a halt to US military operations, an end to the naval blockade and economic war, and the release of the Islamic Republic's assets.

Mehdi Karroubi requested Masoud Pezeshkian to meet with Donald Trump to achieve lasting peace. Karroubi attributed the difficult living conditions to past policies and sanctions and emphasized the need for historic decisions. He urged Pezeshkian to act in the capacity of president and use this opportunity for constructive dialogue.

Kayhan newspaper wrote that damages to Iran's industries and shortages must be compensated by the US and Gulf Arab countries. The newspaper emphasized that Gulf countries are responsible for the damages to Iran and must pay reparations. Kayhan also referred to international laws and the role of these countries in military aggression.

Babak Negahdari, head of the Parliament Research Center, said the Leader of the Revolution is concerned about poverty, corruption, and discrimination, and these concerns should be reflected in officials' decisions. He emphasized that families under economic pressure should not be left alone in demanding justice. He also noted that some groups benefit from the revolution's resources but do not take responsibility in defending the country.

Donald Trump called the Islamic Republic the world's largest state sponsor of terrorism in his speech at the UN General Assembly. He also said that Iran's acquisition of nuclear weapons could enable more extensive attacks. These remarks were made at the UN General Assembly.

Shayan Samiei stated that the Islamic Republic pursues three main goals at the United Nations: narrative warfare, behind-the-scenes diplomacy, and bargaining to reduce pressure. He added that Tehran is trying to prevent diplomatic isolation by involving Pezeshkian and Araqchi. The aim is also to turn the current crisis into leverage for negotiation.

Donald Trump threatened the Islamic Republic on the first day of the UN General Assembly. He said if any activity is observed in the underground complex of Kuh-e-Kalang, American forces will destroy it. This site is near the Natanz nuclear facilities.

Mohammad Qaedi said that the continuation of flight cancellations between Iran and neighboring countries has made travel for students, small traders, and those traveling for treatment or family visits more difficult and costly. This situation may increase Iran's dependence on land routes through Turkey, Iraq, and Armenia. It also negatively affects tourism and small businesses.
Reza Goharzad said Zelensky's welcome of trilateral talks with the US and Russia indicates a shift toward negotiation. He added this proposal could push Putin to negotiate a ceasefire and peace path.

Mahmoud Nemati won the second gold medal for Iran in karate at the Nagoya Asian Games by defeating Sofiani from Saudi Arabia 6-3 in the 84+ kg category. Nemati also won against opponents from Laos and Nepal in earlier rounds. The Nemati brothers became the second Iranian brother duo to win gold medals in the same Asian Games edition.

Iranian female swimmers are banned from participating in the Asian Games swimming competitions in Nagoya due to Islamic Republic regulations. Female swimmers from Palestine and some other Muslim countries are competing in these events. This report is by Somayeh Mehri from Iran International.

The monthly human rights report for September 1405 highlights widespread human rights violations in Iran. Cases include executions without fair justice, suppression of freedom of expression, and increased violence against women. The report emphasizes the urgent need for attention from the international community and the Iranian government.

Mohammad Jafar Qaempanah, the executive deputy of Masoud Pezeshkian, referred to the livelihood problems of teachers during a school visit on the first day of school reopening. He said that part of the hardships should be borne by the government and part by teachers and the people. Qaempanah also emphasized the importance of resilience and preserving Iran's dignity.

On the first day of Mehr, coinciding with the start of the school year, several flag-bearing vans and vehicles equipped with loudspeakers playing elegies entered Barati School in Garmdareh. Additionally, some military forces entered the school premises. This report was sent by a citizen to Iran International.
Hermoso restaurant in Tehran was closed due to non-compliance with hijab rules. This news was reported by the HRANA news agency. The page associated with the restaurant announced this issue.
